sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 2 x Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived on site and debriefing with night shift.
Commencing patrol towards Aotea Square. Eventful night but not expecting anything to roll over to this morning.
Welfare check Starbucks, Localito, Queen St McDonald's and 77 Convenience store. Continuing towards Aotea Square.
All clear, no issues. Standing by for presence.
Library area and Lorne Street all clear. Heading towards Skycity.
Arrived corner Federal and Victoria Street, welfare checks on both 77 Convenience stores, Coffee Club and Eighty Fed. Standby.
Wellesley Street all clear. Heading through Elliot Street.
Elliot and Darby Street all clear, all businesses no issues. Heading towards High Street.
High Street and Vulcan Lane all clear. Heading towards O'Connell Street.
O'Connell Street and Freyberg Square all clear. Heading to Chancery Square.
Chancery Square all clear. Standing by for presence.
Call from Localito regarding screaming outside their store, then advised Police are here and hung up. Continuing standby.
Pocket Park, Fort Lane, Fort Street, Jo&Joe's, Imperial Lane and Wilson Carpark all clear. Heading towards Gore Street.
Welfare checks on Auckland. Heading to the office to let in guards.
Standing by for guards to arrive.
Guards for 2nd Team onsite, standing by for response calls whilst debriefing.
Debriefing complete. Commencing patrols down Queen Street to Commercial Bay; 2nd Team commenced patrols up Queen Street.
Welfare checks on opened stores, no issues from staff; Lower Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Shortland Street clear. Arriving Commercial Bay.
Commencing welfare checks on Commercial Bay.
Commercial Bay welfare sweep complete; McDonald's Britomart all clear, public area clear.
Departing Commercial Bay, heading to Chancery Square.
1st half of High Street clear; Freyberg Square check clear.
Chancery Square patrol sweep clear; completing sweep on High Street.
High Street sweep complete (note: a market is on at High Street, no issues). Heading towards Victoria Street.
Patrol sweep Victoria Street clear; Federal Street quick sweep complete. Arriving the Cathedral Church.
The Cathedral Church welfare sweep complete. Heading to Albert Street.
Albert Street welfare sweep clear; Albert Mart clear. Making way back to Fort Street.
Customs Street no issues. Continuing patrol to Fort Street.
Walkthrough Fort Street, no issues. Heading to Gore Street.

Gore Street welfare checks Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Smiley Mart, Chargrill, King Noodle complete. Lower Queen Street welfare sweeps complete; standing by lower Queen Street, foot traffic quiet.
No response calls, no issues. Heading back to HQ for route changeover with 2nd Team.
Standing by HQ, currently debriefing with 2nd Team.
Debrief with 2nd Team complete, route changeover commenced. Commencing patrol up Queen Street whilst 2nd Team patrols down Queen Street.
Welfare checks on stores complete, no issues:
Aotea Square full sweep complete. Heading to Lorne Street via Auckland Library.
Auckland Library sweep complete. Arriving Lorne Street.
Response call from Ippondo requesting assistance to move a vagrant loitering outside the store. Heading there now.
Ippondo response call sorted, vagrant moved along, no further issues. Continuing patrol.
Victoria Street complete, no issues. Welfare checks 77 Convenience, Coffee Club, Amelias Cafe clear. Heading down to Elliot Street.
Elliot Street and Darby Street walkthrough clear. Upper Queen Street welfare checks complete; standing by Upper Queen Street before 30 minute break.
No response calls, no issues. Heading back to HQ.
Standing by HQ whilst on break.
Morning shift concluded, handover to afternoon shift complete.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Guard handover complete, standing by in office for debrief with B Team then commence patrols.
Commencing lower Queen Street patrols starting from Darby Street.
Arrived Darby Street, commencing full sweep along with Elliot Street.
Full sweep Elliot Stables, the shopping centre, Darby Street and all open stores all clear. Heading up Victoria Street West.
Victoria Street West welfare check 77 Convenience store and other open stores all clear. Walking down Federal Street to the Cathedral to commence sweep.
Full sweep St Patrick's Square, Cathedral, Liston House, Federal Square and welfare check all stores all clear. Patrolling down Wyndham Street to Queen Street.
Quick sweep and welfare check along all stores within the street, all clear.
Welfare checking down lower Queen and all stores to Commercial Bay.
Arrived Commercial Bay, all stores lower Queen Street full sweep all clear. Massive gathering at Commercial Bay; maintaining presence, standing by for response calls.
Stand down security presence at Commercial Bay, heading back to HQ to charge ops phone (low battery).
Arrived HQ, standing by charging ops phone, waiting for response calls.
Commencing floor checks before heading out for patrols.
Commencing patrol on Queen Street towards Aotea Square.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street, Unichem Pharmacy, Localito, Footlocker, all clear.
Aotea Square full sweep completed, no issues. Standing by, foot count higher than usual.
Lorne Street full sweep all clear.
High Street, Fort Street, Fort Lane, Gore Street all clear, welfare check on stores. Standing by for response calls.
Received a response call from Ippondo Queen Street regarding a male vagrant entering the store, stealing goods and walking out.

Arrived response location; male vagrant posted outside the store at the front entrance with the products beside his leg. Approached and asked for the products back but he was not compliant; attempted to retrieve but was rejected. Male stood up and walked away; followed keeping a safe distance, repeatedly asking for the products. Police called and notified of our location.
Male vagrant entered a bus trying to escape; still followed him asking for the products back.
Took the male vagrant off the bus due to the bus going out of our jurisdiction. Waiting for Police to arrive.
Police arrived and apprehended the vagrant. Standing by for statements and any assistance needed.
Leaving the incident location; statements and assistance with Police completed. Continuing patrols.
Full sweep Aotea Square, no issues. Heading to HQ to dispose of the HOTC shirt worn by the vagrant involved in the response incident, then continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Full sweep Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Shortland Street all clear. Heading to Commercial Bay.
Arrived Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
A large group of minors present around the area shouting and disturbing the public. Standing by for any issues that would occur.
Standing down from Commercial Bay full sweep and welfare check all open stores, all clear. Heading to Cathedral for sweep.
Wyndham Street from Albert Street going down all clear. Commencing sweep for Cathedral.
Cathedral St Patricks and Liston House (no vagrants seen) all clear. Walking down Federal Street.
Federal Street check complete, no issues. Heading to Victoria Street West for full sweep.
Victoria Street sweep complete, welfare check all open stores all clear. Walking down Victoria Street to High Street.
Arrived High Street, welfare checking area. Heading to Chancery Square / Freyberg for full sweep.
Full sweep High Street, Chancery Square / Freyberg Place all clear.
Currently on Fort Lane / Fort Street standing by checking for issues.
Stand down standby at Fort Lane, welfare check on open businesses all clear. Walking down Fort Street for full sweep.
Full sweep Gore Street, Commerce Street and Gore Lane all clear. Walking down Customs Street to show presence before heading back to HQ for 30 minute break.
Customs Street check all clear. Heading back to HQ for 30 min break.
Arrived HQ, commencing 30 minute break, charging the ops phone and responding to any calls.
Afternoon shift concluded, handing over to night shift. Incident media (Ippondo response) on file.
Equipment handover: 2 x vest, 2 x bodycam, 4 x keys, 2 x keytag, 1 x ops phone.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:25 – 17:00)
items: Debriefing with A Team complete. Commencing patrol up Queen Street with welfare checks (Cotton On, Foot Locker, McDonald's and additional stores).
Sweep complete Aotea, no issues. Headed to Victoria Street.
Victoria Street sweep complete. Headed to the Cathedral.
Cathedral and Federal Street sweep complete, no issues. Heading to Lorne Street.
Auckland Library welfare check complete. Heading Elliot Street.
Walkthrough Elliot Street complete, no issues.
Upper Queen Street welfare sweep complete. Standing by Queen Street maintaining presence.
Headed back to HQ for debrief and route changeover.
Debrief with A Team complete, route change. Commencing welfare checks down Queen Street.
Full sweep Lower Queen Street, Vulcan Lane, Shortland Street, Fort, Gore Street complete. Making way to Commercial Bay.
Arrived Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Commercial Bay clear; welfare check clear.
Albert Street sweep complete, welfare check Albert Mart clear.
Heading back to HQ for debrief with Team 1 and route changeover with Team 1 afternoon shift.
Standing by whilst debrief with A Team afternoon shift.
Commencing welfare sweep up Queen Street.
Welfare sweep up Queen Street clear. Heading to Aotea Square.
Aotea sweep complete. Heading to Elliot Street.
Victoria welfare sweep complete. Heading to Lorne Street via Queen Street.
Upper Queen Street sweeps complete. Standing by Queen Street.
Heading back to HQ for 30 min.
A Team standing down, no issues to handover.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:35 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Night guards on shift, suiting up.
Standby charging ops phone (4%). Awaiting response calls.
Heading out on patrols, phone at 30%.
Check in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues.
Check in Britomart Maccas, no issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Dealt with an individual asked to be removed from Britomart Maccas due to asking customers for food; he gained distance from the site, no further issues.
Commercial Bay full sweep complete, all clear.
Welfare check Albert Street Convenience store, no issues. Heading back to HQ.
Floor checks complete. Continuing Alpha route.
Check in 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear, no nearby calls. Alpha route complete.
Check in Queen Street Maccas, no issues.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square / Kitchener Street, all clear.
Full sweep Fort Street, all clear.
Check in Gore Street, all clear. Beta route complete.
Check in Aotea Gifts, no issues.
Response call to Queen Street Maccas due to 2 vagrants sleeping inside and one individual not ordering food but claiming paid customers' food.
Arrived on site, removed the individuals from site.
Queen Street Maccas all clear, no further issues.
Check in St Patrick's Cathedral church, all clear.
Check in 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Full sweep Victoria Street, all clear.
Check in corner Lorne Street / Wakefield, all clear.
Check in Aotea Square, all clear.
Check in Queen Street Maccas, no issues. Heading back to HQ for 30 minute break.
Check in 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Check in St Patrick's Cathedral church, all clear.
Full sweep Wyndham Street, all clear.
Check in Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Check in Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay, all clear.
Check in Fort Street / Wilson Carpark, all clear.
Check in Chancery Square / Freyberg, all clear.
Check in corner Lorne Street / Wakefield, all clear.
Check in Aotea Square, all clear.
Check in Queen Street Maccas, no issues. Heading back to HQ awaiting changeover.
